enumDescriptions: Prefer the native simhelper sidecar, then idb_companion, then the idb CLI.
Always use the native simhelper sidecar (correct H.264 video, in-process HID). Fails if the binary is missing.
Always use the idb_companion gRPC backend (low-latency input and video). Fails if idb_companion is not installed.
Always use the idb command-line backend.
vscodesim.simulator.backend.description: How the simulator panel connects to booted simulators for video and input.

vscodesim.simulator.sandbox.description: Run the simhelper sidecar under sandbox-exec (no network access, file writes limited to CoreSimulator and temp directories).

vscodesim.simulator.fps.description: Video frame rate. Applied when a panel opens (the stream is fixed for the panel's lifetime).

vscodesim.simulator.scale.description: Video resolution as a fraction of the simulator's native resolution. Applied when a panel opens.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:sidecar && npm run compile
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
